title: 第一卷 第14章 装修新家
slug: 一路逃荒一路富手握空间带飞全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

村边那间旧屋比沈鹿溪记忆里的还破。

土坯墙裂了好几道缝，屋顶的茅草塌了一半，露着天。

门板歪斜着挂在门框上，一推就吱呀呀地响，屋里头全是灰和碎土块，角落里还有老鼠洞。

柳荞娘站在门口看了一眼，嘴唇抿得紧紧的，没吭声。

沈大山蹲下来摸了摸墙根，闷声说了句：“墙根还是结实的，能修。”

柳老爹绕着屋子转了一圈，拍了拍土坯墙：“主体没塌，就是顶上得重新铺。青山，你回去把家里那捆茅草拉过来。青河，去村口看看谁家有多余的木料，买几根回来。”

大舅柳青山二话不说，转身向外走去。

二舅柳青河掏出了钱袋子颠了颠：“姐夫，木料的钱我来出。”

沈大山涨红了脸，张了张嘴想说什么，柳青河已经跑了。

沈鹿溪挽起袖子，开始往外搬屋里的碎石和烂泥。

“娘，你去打两桶水来。爹，你把门板卸下来修一修。”沈鹿溪说着，转头看向沈小满：“小满，你去捡柴火，等会要生火烧水。”

一家四口加上柳老爹，五个人撸起袖子干了起来。

柳老爹干了一辈子体力活，手脚利落得很，他拿着柴刀把歪掉的房梁扳正，又用麻绳绑紧，嘴里骂骂咧咧的：“王桂花那个黑心烂肺的老婆子，给了这么个破烂棚子，也好意思叫房子。”

沈鹿溪一边搬石头一边笑：“外公，有个遮风挡雨的地方就行了。等我赚了钱，到时候再盖新的。”

柳老爹瞪了她一眼，嘴上骂着，手上的活倒是干得更快了。

柳青山很快拉着一车茅草回来了，连着柳青河采买的木料也一同拉了回来，还顺道借了一套工具。

几个男人上房铺茅草，沈鹿溪和柳荞娘在屋里清扫。

灰尘扫出去了好几簸箕，老鼠洞用碎石头堵上，墙缝也拿泥巴糊了一遍。

地面是夯土的，柳荞娘打了水泼上去，用扫帚来回刷了几遍，总算看着干净了些。

忙到太阳偏西，屋子的样子总算能看了。

这屋里只有一间正房和一间小灶房，正房够摆一张炕和一张桌子，灶房里也足够支一口锅。

家当几乎没有。

从沈家大院搬出来的时候，王桂花只让带了二房自己的铺盖卷和几件换洗衣裳，别的一概不许动。

锅碗瓢盆全没有。

沈鹿溪对这些早有准备。

“外公，您先歇着，我去趟镇上。”

柳老爹擦了把汗：“去镇上干啥？天都快黑了。”

“买锅。家里连口锅都没有，今晚吃啥?”

柳老爹摸了摸腰间的钱袋子：“锅的钱外公出......“

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The old house at the edge of the village was worse than what Shen Luxi remembered.

There were several cracks in the adobe wall, and half of the thatch on the roof collapsed, exposing the sky.

The door panel hung crookedly on the door frame and creaked when pushed. The room was filled with dust and broken soil, and there were mouse holes in the corners.

Liu Qiaoniang stood at the door and took a look, pursed her lips tightly and said nothing.

Shen Dashan knelt down and touched the base of the wall, and said in a low voice: "The base of the wall is still strong and can be repaired."

Father Liu walked around the house and patted the adobe wall: "The main body has not collapsed, but the top needs to be re-paved. Qingshan, go back and pull over the bundle of thatch from home. Qinghe, go to the entrance of the village to see who has extra wood and buy a few pieces back."

Uncle Liu Qingshan turned around and walked out without saying a word.

Second uncle Liu Qinghe took out his money bag and shook it: "Brother-in-law, I will pay for the wood."

Shen Dashan blushed and opened his mouth to say something, but Liu Qinghe had already ran away.

Shen Luxi rolled up his sleeves and began to move the gravel and mud out of the house.

"Mom, go get two buckets of water. Dad, take off the door panel and repair it." Shen Luxi said, turning to look at Shen Xiaoman: "Xiaoman, go collect firewood, we will light a fire to boil water later."

A family of four, including Father Liu, rolled up their sleeves and got to work.

Father Liu had been doing manual labor all his life, and his hands and feet were very nimble. He used a hatchet to straighten the crooked beams, and tied them tightly with hemp ropes. He cursed: "Wang Guihua, that black-hearted old woman, has the nerve to call it a house after being given such a shabby shed."

Shen Luxi smiled while moving the stones: "Grandpa, it's enough to have a shelter from the wind and rain. I will build a new one when I make money."

Father Liu glared at her, cursed, and worked faster.

Liu Qingshan quickly came back with a cart of thatch, along with the wood that Liu Qinghe had purchased, and also borrowed a set of tools along the way.

Several men went up to the house to spread thatch, while Shen Luxi and Liu Qiaoniang were cleaning the house.

Several dustpans were used to sweep out the dust, the mouse holes were plugged with gravel, and the cracks in the wall were filled with mud.

The ground was made of rammed earth. Liu Qiaoniang poured water on it and brushed it back and forth with a broom several times. Finally it looked a little cleaner.

I was so busy that the sun set to the west, and I could finally see what the house looked like.

There is only one main room and a small kitchen in this house. The main room is big enough for a kang and a table, and the kitchen is big enough for a pot.

There are almost no belongings.

When moving out of the Shen family compound, Wang Guihua was only allowed to bring her own bedroll and a few changes of clothes from the second room, and she was not allowed to touch anything else.

There were no pots and pans.

Shen Luxi had already prepared for this.

"Grandpa, please rest first while I go to town."

Father Liu wiped his sweat: "What are you doing in town? It's almost dark."

"Buy a pot. I don't even have a pot at home. What are you going to eat tonight?"

Father Liu touched the money bag at his waist: "Grandpa will pay for the pot..."
